preconditions.description: The number of test cases `t` is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(x == int(x) and 1 <= x <= 10**18 for x in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each test case value `x` is an integer between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(count_nice_staircases(x)) for x in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each test case `x`, the output is the count of distinct nice staircases that can be built using no more than `x` cells, where a nice staircase with `n` stairs is one that can be covered by `n` disjoint squares.

postconditions.expression: all(count_nice_staircases(x) == len({n for n in range(1, x+1) if is_nice_staircase(n) and sum_staircase_cells(n) <= x}))
postconditions.description: The count of nice staircases for `x` is the number of distinct `n` such that the staircase with `n` stairs is nice and its total cell count is ≤ `x`.
